prompt.generated_prompt_string: A photorealistic eye-level bust-up close-up portrait of an adult Japanese woman with large sparkling eyes, rosy igari-style cheeks, soft pink lips, natural luminous skin, airy bangs, and soft waves decorated with pastel ribbon clips and tiny pearl pins. She wears a fluffy white angora knit sweater with a cute ribbon collar, oversized sleeves partly covering her hands, dainty heart earrings, and a delicate gold chain with a small crystal. Both hands lightly frame her cheeks; she has a gentle head tilt, a beaming warm smile, and direct eye contact. Set her against a dreamy blurred pastel background with bokeh lights and no text. Use large frontal diffusion at approximately 5200K and a soft hair rim light for high-key illumination, gentle bloom, natural eye catchlights, and a subtle halo. Canon EOS R5 with an 85mm f/1.2 prime lens, shallow depth of field, creamy whites, soft pinks, restrained highlight bloom, fluffy knit texture, and visible natural skin texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, childlike appearance, sexual pose, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No asset is required. An approved-adult face reference is optional and, when attached, must preserve the adult person's face, facial structure, and likeness. Optional wardrobe references should preserve the white angora knit, ribbon collar, pastel clips, pearl pins, heart earrings, and delicate necklace. The bokeh background may be replaced while keeping the bright pastel high-key mood.

changes: Changed the 18-year-old girl wording to an explicitly adult woman and excluded childlike appearance.
Preserved the kawaii idol close-up, sweater styling, pastel accessories, pose, and bright bokeh direction.
